transcript: Something I'm proud of. Hmm. I'm proud of working in finance for three years now, it's not easy and a lot of people leave. At my current company I do many things, accounts payable, some reports, and I help with month-end. My manager trusts me because she gives me a lot of work. Last year we changed our accounting software and it was a big project for the whole finance team. It took a long time and there were many difficulties, but in the end it was done and now everyone uses it. I helped with testing, I checked some of the reports to see if the numbers were the same as the old system. Some were not the same, and I told the project team. So I contributed to that project being successful. I'm also proud that I'm always on time and I never miss work, reliability is very important in finance. My colleagues say I'm very dependable. So I would say I'm proud of being reliable and helping the team with the software project. Thank you for listening to my answer.
